label: Shop front
description: Home, Products, About, Visit us and Contact for a business that sells goods. Add the shop extension later to take orders online.

site.name: Your shop
site.description: A shop front website that shows what you sell and how to find you.

pages.name: Home
pages.title: Welcome
pages.description: What you sell, what makes it worth buying here and where to start.

sections.title: Welcome
sections.content: Tell visitors what you sell and why they should buy it from you, in their words rather than yours. Then send them to your products.

sections.title: Start here
sections.content: Point to your best sellers, your newest arrivals or a gift guide so first-time visitors know where to look.

pages.name: Products
pages.title: Products
pages.description: Browse what is for sale, with the details a customer needs to choose.

sections.title: Our range
sections.content: Group your products so customers can find what they want quickly, and say what is special about the range. Add each product with a clear photo, a price and what is included.

sections.title: Delivery and returns
sections.content: Say how long delivery takes, what it costs and how customers can send something back. Clear answers here prevent most questions before they are asked.

pages.name: About
pages.title: About us
pages.description: Who makes or chooses what you sell, and why.

sections.title: Our story
sections.content: Explain where your products come from and why you sell them. Customers buy from people they trust, so say who you are and what you stand for.

pages.name: Visit us
pages.title: Visit us
pages.description: Where the shop is, when it is open and how to get there.

sections.title: Opening hours
sections.content: List your opening hours, including holidays and any days you are closed.

sections.title: Finding the shop
sections.content: Add your address, parking and public transport details, and mention anything that helps first-time visitors, such as the colour of the door or the nearest landmark.

pages.name: Contact
pages.title: Contact us
pages.description: How to reach the shop with a question about an order or a product.

sections.title: Get in touch
sections.content: Give the best way to reach you about an order, a product or a return, and say how quickly you usually reply.
